props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with every row after each add, edit, move and removal.

props.name: createRow
props.description: Builds the blank row that Add appends.

props.name: renderRow
props.description: Draws the fields of one row.

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: What one row is, in lower case — used in button names and announcements: “Remove contact 2”.

props.name: min
props.description: Fewest rows. Remove is disabled at this count.

props.name: max
props.description: Most rows. Add is disabled at this count.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: Text on the add button. Defaults to “Add” and the item label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
